_note: deadline-signals-on-the-dashboard (REQ-SIG-004, board DqDashboard Termijnsignalen): termSignalFrom is the day a case enters the last quarter of its term, so the dashboard filters late cases and cases with under a quarter of their term left with one server-side filter. Declared after `deadline`, which it reads: save-time calculations run in declaration order and see the ones before them. case 1.62.0.

termSignalFrom.description: The day the case enters the last quarter of its term: start date plus three quarters of the days from start to deadline. A case is a deadline signal once this day has come (late, or less than a quarter of its term left), as board DqDashboard's Termijnsignalen card draws it (REQ-SIG-004). Materialised so the dashboard can filter on it server-side; it is recomputed whenever the case is saved, and the term engine saves the case when the deadline moves. Empty without a deadline. Without a start date the term counts from the deadline itself, so the case signals only once late. After deploying, run occ openregister:rematerialise-calculations.
